I know I wish my parents cared. When I was twelve I would be gone for days at a time. I was drinking every weekend and smoking all day. By sixteen my own mother was buying me cigarettes. At 39 I still smoke now 

By forteen I was getting alcohol poisoning from drinking too much one time I drink too much vodka. I was sick for three days dry heaving nonstop. Appendicitis at age 23.

Ruined many relationships and old friendships by drunken buffoonery. By twenty five everyone abandoned me looking back I know why I was out of control. I had no self-awareness or control. I was easily influenced by influence in town and whenever I was inebriated, I did things that I would never do. They still say ‘that’s was the real you’ I’ve been sober 8.5 years 

At age 27 they found me dead upstairs overdose twice they took the stuff never asked what it was why I did it if I planned on doing it again and if there was anything they could do to help. It broke me this year having a mid life crisis. No longer speak to my own parents (who though loved me) 

Even though I’ve been almost 9 years sober since moving and changing my phone number, I have not made any calls from the age of 30. I’ll be forty in December. I only have my two sons which is enough to keep me going !

Every single, one of my old friends, including my own father said some of the most hurtful things to me. No one has ever given me credit for any of my achievements or accomplishments. I get bullied constantly whenever I try to reunite with any of them, it’s really sad to think that a good hearted person from a good family who was always putting others first always cared about his friends and the worst you could say I ever did was be promiscuous and have chemical dependency is now dead to half a town and never will see anyone ever again. I will die alone knowing I’ve came so far and nobody cares. It is the brutal truth we are all alone bye
